title: 冰雹是怎么长大的 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible layered strokes and grainy hatching, slate blue, ice white and warm ochre

pages.scene: One single round hailstone of white and clear ice, about as big as a walnut, lying on its own. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it.
